title: Stable complete coordinates for multisets of points via basic $r$-symmetric tropical polynomials
summary: A multiset of $n$ unordered points in $\mathbb{R}^r$ -- a point cloud, or, for $r=2$, a persistence barcode of birth-death pairs -- is a point of the orbit space $\mathbb{R}^{nr}/S_n$ for the symmetric group $S_n$ permuting the rows of an $n \times r$ matrix; a separating family of invariants on this space is exactly a complete set of permutation-independent coordinates.
